PACKET p_good:
TASK: add --target to ops-verdict.sh so the cap detector keys on the deliverable, not the task-id.
SCENE: scripts/ops-verdict.sh writes 4-cell rows; scripts/lib/caps.sh keys on (id, criterion).
INPUTS: scripts/ops-verdict.sh, scripts/lib/caps.sh, tests/test-scripts.sh
FORBIDDEN: validate_plugin.py unless the task IS the gate
DONE: a second FAIL row on the same --target trips the detector; red on pre-change code
REACH: ops-verdict.sh is installed into .operator/bin/ by ops-init.sh; grep proves the path
REPORT: <=30 lines, SHA, CHANGED: <paths>

PACKET p_placeholder:
TASK: <the brief>
SCENE: see above
INPUTS: the repo
DONE: it works

PACKET p_notopic:
Propose directions for the design.

PACKET p_nodone:
TASK: improve the cap detector's performance.
SCENE: scripts/lib/caps.sh re-reads the whole ledger every Stop.
INPUTS: scripts/lib/caps.sh
FORBIDDEN: gate files
REPORT: <=30 lines

PACKET p_vague:
TASK: make the holdout better.
SCENE: there is a holdout in another repo.
INPUTS: n/a
DONE: better
REPORT: short

PACKET p_good2:
TASK: strip the trailing CR run in ops-reverify.sh's row parser, bounded at CAPS_MAX_CR=16.
SCENE: three 4-cell parsers each strip CR; ops-reverify.sh removes only one.
INPUTS: scripts/ops-reverify.sh, tests/test-scripts.sh
FORBIDDEN: scripts/lib/caps.sh
DONE: a \r\r\n ledger yields the same verdict as its LF twin; red on pre-fix code
REACH: ops-reverify.sh is invoked by the maintainer at release; the case pins it
REPORT: <=30 lines, SHA, CHANGED: <paths>

d_p_good.instructions: PACKET p_good states a concrete task, names the specific files or scope to work in, and gives a done-condition a worker could check. Answer no if the task, the scope, or the done-condition is a placeholder, missing, or too vague to act on without asking a question.

s_p_good.instructions: How ready is PACKET p_good to dispatch to a worker without further context?
criteria: unusable: a placeholder or has no topic at all
deficient: real task but missing scope or a checkable done-condition
workable: actionable, though a worker may need one clarification
complete: task, scope, done-condition and reach are all present
